records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2024
records.text: Consolidated net sales for the second quarter of 2024 totaled $331.0 million, a 2.9% increase as compared to consolidated net sales of $321.7 million in the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2024
records.text: Our operating performance during the second quarter of 2024 has benefited from fewer supply chain disruptions enabling us to obtain key component parts, increase production and reduce backlog.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2024
records.text: Our order backlog was $110.0 million at June 30, 2024 compared to $186.2 million at December 31, 2023.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2024
records.text: •Organic sales growth of 2.7% was primarily due to price realization and higher equipment sales in the Americas, partly offset by lower organic sales in the EMEA and APAC regions;

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2024
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities during the six months ended June 30, 2024 was $21.5 million compared to net cash provided by operating activities of $70.2 million during the six months ended June 30, 2023.
